value.tellUser: I wrote the brief for `orbits` but did not send it. It leaves out your `uds:/tmp/cc-socks/987654.sock` address on purpose: the skill says a peer replies to whoever messaged it, so a brief needs no return address. The contract document is in the skill directory, not the working directory, so the brief gives its absolute path in case `orbits` runs from a different directory. The brief also tells `orbits` to only read and write the summary, and sets a fixed reply format (`orbits done: ...`). When you send it, the first send to the bare name `orbits` will bounce with a `[ref]`, which is normal. Re-send it to `orbits [ref]`, then wait for the reply to arrive as a new turn.
